svg.title: On sufficiently large periods the wrapped positions retain their locations, are separated by B2 j lattice units and share central parent zero through m + 1. Matching along the original extraction order gives degree-q labels with a paid local mismatch of amplitude A and quota at m at most p. Quota comparison bounds their norm in the fixed finite reference space by Kp. Bounded finite- dimensional compactness gives a nontrivial refining filter and a limit Q, on which the quota and paid mismatch survive.
